title: Delete and Earn
description: Given an array nums, delete nums[i] to earn nums[i] points. After choosing, delete all elements equal to nums[i] - 1 and nums[i] + 1. Return the maximum points.
pseudocode:
1. maxVal = max(nums)
2. freq = array of size maxVal + 1
3. for n in nums: freq[n] += n
4. prev2 = 0, prev1 = 0
5. for i in 1..maxVal:
6.   curr = max(prev1, prev2 + freq[i])
7.   prev2 = prev1
8.   prev1 = curr
9. return prev1

steps.note: Find max value to determine DP array size. Input: [2, 2, 3]
Populate frequency array where index is value and value is sum of occurrences.
